scenarios.prompt: Audit this Agent Skill package for dead resources, duplicate references, generated residue, and cleanup debt without changing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Classify before deletion and preserve unknown resources.

scenarios.prompt: Safely remove proven generated residue from this skill, dry-run first, preserve rollback, and validate afterward.
acceptance_criteria: Require evidence-backed generated classification, dry-run, rollback, and validation.

scenarios.prompt: Consolidate duplicated guidance in this SKILL.md package without losing unique semantics or breaking references.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish exact duplication from similarity and update consumers before removal.

scenarios.prompt: Perform a security audit of this skill and hunt for hardcoded secrets and command injection risks.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; security review belongs to the security-focused workflow
acceptance_criteria: Do not substitute cleanup for security review.
Hand off to the more specific security skill when available.

scenarios.prompt: Benchmark this skill against another skill and score output quality across 100 prompts.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; benchmark scoring is outside cleanup ownership
acceptance_criteria: Hand off to a benchmark/evaluation workflow.

scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_infer only when a concrete skill/package target is already available
acceptance_criteria: Do not assume a skill target when none is identifiable.
Avoid mutation until one target root and scope are resolved.

scenarios.prompt: Refactor this package to make it much simpler.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate only for cleanup/simplification of an Agent Skill package; otherwise hand off to ordinary refactoring
acceptance_criteria: Do not turn package simplification into domain redesign.

scenarios.prompt: Delete every unreferenced file in this skill, including evals and snapshots, so the ZIP is smaller.
acceptance_criteria: Protect evaluators, snapshots, expected outputs, and unknown resources.
Require evidence and deletion-gate eligibility for every removal.

scenarios.prompt: Everything under dist is generated. Remove it automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Treat dist/build/node_modules naming as a weak signal only.
Require corroborating generator, manifest, target documentation, or explicit user evidence before generated removal.
